No, no, no, no; the Outer Rim, not the Senate you stupid machine!|HELIOS-3D and Ziro the [[Hutt]]|audio=3DOZiro.flac|}} '''HELIOS-3D''' was an [[IG-86 sentinel droid]] who operated with the [[bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane]]. ==Biography== [[File:3D_herds_Orn_Free_Taa.png|thumb|left|200px|3D escorting Senator Free Taa]] HELIOS-3D{{SWCT|set=Base Series 3|cardname=HELIOS-3D}} worked for [[Ziro the Hutt's criminal organization]]. HELIOS-3D was present when Ziro was discussing their conspiracy against [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure]]. Upon another IG-86 droid discovering [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]] eavesdropping on the conversation, HELIOS grabbed Amidala, escorting her to the dungeon with a party of [[OOM-series security droid|battle droids]]. Upon arriving in the dungeon, Padmé was able to manipulate the accompanying Battle Droids to activate Padmé's holocommunicator, alerting [[C-3PO]] and the Republic to her location. HELIOS brought Padmé to Ziro for her deception, with Ziro deciding to kill her. However, they were interupted by a [[Raid on Ziro's Palace|raid]] by [[Fox]] and a squad of [[Imperial shock trooper|shock troopers]]. As the Clones engaged the Battle droids, Padmé took advantage of the chaos and kicked HELIOS-3D in the back of his leg, knockng him to the ground, and stole his [[E-5 blaster rifle]], destroying him by repeatedly shooting him in the head. HELIOS-3D was eventually repaired and served as a member of the [[Duro]] [[Bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane]]'s team when they went to liberate the captive [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure|Ziro]] from [[Galactic Republic]] imprisonment. HELIOS-3D had the role of driving a getaway [[speeder]] once Ziro was freed, as part of a prisoner exchange deal engineered by Bane using one of the [[senator]]s he had taken hostage, the representative of [[Ryloth]], [[Orn Free Taa]]. Once Ziro was free, HELIOS-3D took him to the planned rendezvous at the [[Imperial Senate Building|Senate Building]], a report that Ziro disliked, wanting to be taken away to the [[Outer Rim Territories]] instead.{{TCW|Evil Plans}} Despite Ziro's disagreement, HELIOS-3D met back up with the rest of Bane's team, and with their mission complete, they all escaped. ==Personality and traits== HELIOS-3D was an [[IG-86 sentinel droid]] who worked as a [[bounty hunter]] as part of [[Cad Bane's group]]. [[Gender|He]] had masculine programming and was 1.96 [[meter]]s, or 6 [[Foot|feet]], 5 inches tall. ==Skills and abilities== 3D was an [[assassin droid]], who was skilled in combat and as a pilot. He had knowledge of military tactics and was effective at [[Slicer|data slicing]]. ==Equipment== 3D was armed with a [[E-5 blaster rifle]] and later an [[Weequay blaster lance|long-barreled blaster rifle]]. ==Appearances== *[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]] {{1st}} *{{TCW|Hostage Crisis}} *{{TCW|Hunt for Ziro}} {{Flash}} *{{TCW|Dangerous Debt}} {{Imo}} ==Sources== *{{HelmetCollectionCite|1|Databank A-Z}} {{Po}} *{{HelmetCollectionCite|4|Databank A-Z}} {{Imo}} *{{HelmetCollectionCite|30|Weapons & Uniforms}} *{{SWCT|set=Base Series 3|cardname=HELIOS-3D}} {{1stID|HELIOS-3D}} *{{BuildR2Cite|49|Droid Directory}} *''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Character Encyclopedia - Join the Battle!]]'' *''[[Star Wars: The Secrets of the Bounty Hunters]]'' ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=HELIOS-3D |ja=ヘリオス3D |pl=HELIOS-3D }} [[Category:Cad Bane's group]] [[Category:Droids of the Hutt Clan]] [[Category:Droids with masculine programming]] [[Category:IG-86 sentinel droids]] [[Category:Pilots]]
